bugs_found: apply_fee raises TypeError instead of ValueError for negative fee_pct, creating inconsistent validation behavior
transfer is not atomic: account_from is debited before account_to credit is guaranteed, so a failing credit can corrupt balances
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal, allowing type errors or mixed numeric behavior unlike other money functions
loan_payment and compound_interest silently truncate years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), changing financial terms without explicit validation
fx_convert does not validate rate positivity or finiteness, allowing negative, zero, NaN, or infinite FX rates
